name: BRISTOL-MYERS SQUIBB CO. Regist
summary: BRISTOL-MYERS SQUIBB CO. Regist refers to Bristol-Myers Squibb, a global biopharmaceutical company engaged in the discovery, development, licensing, manufacturing, marketing, distribution and sale of biopharmaceutical products. The company focuses on areas such as oncology, hematology, immunology, cardiovascular and neuroscience. Bristol-Myers Squibb is headquartered in New York City.
